sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Neuwiedia griffithii is a rhizomatous terrestrial orchid of humid Southeast Asian forests, including Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra. Its leafy portion reaches about 20–30 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The pleated leaves can reach 25 × 4 cm. The pale flowers are small, with floral parts about 6–8 mm long; the dry, hairy capsule is about 7 mm. The genus is unusual among orchids in having three fertile stamens.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use was found for this species.
